## Summary

The EP02 Khmer already reads as speech and keeps every voice axis from EP01 (Jinu short with បាទ/បង, Taeho អូន/បង and ហាៗ except on the cliff call, Deokbae humble with លោកមេធាវី, Bonggu ពូ/ក្មួយ/ហឹៗ, Ki's អា… contempt). Nine KM lines were touched: two stiff or literal phrasings (P07, P33), two register/idiom slips (P35 ពិសា, P08 ទៀងពេល/ផ្ទាល់ភ្នែក), one line that read as a refusal ("I already ate", P32), one hearsay/grammar fix (P38), one modality ambiguity (P54 ដោះលែងបាន could read "can be released"), and the P60 cliff now carries the hearsay with `…គេថា` (E2-F4). All clue words, address forms and repeated lines are unchanged (K-12 inside P21 letter-identical, ខាងលើ at P57, ចេញទៅមុន at P06/P11, ចៅ as an ordinary noun, វឺត… វឺត… twice, "empty" never ក្លែង). Notes for continuity-manager: update the glossary row 「빈 카드」 example to `…គេថា កាតនោះ ទទេស្អាត។`, and add `ក្មេងនោះ` (Ki about Jinu, third person, EP02 P23) to the 애송이 변호사 row.

## Decisions

Uncertainty resolved automatically (what was unclear, what was chosen, why).

- **D2-F2 (P06, P11 `ចេញទៅមុន`):** unclear whether the K-14 echo sounds forced. `មានឡានមួយ ចេញទៅមុន។` is how a Cambodian says "a car left ahead"; it reads as a plain statement on first read. Kept; the `ទៅមុន` fallback is not needed.
- **D2-F6 (P54 subject):** unclear whether the line needs `លោក ដុកបែ`. The source omits the subject and the ដោះលែង / បីថ្ងៃ chain points to the only person released; adding the name would be more explicit than the Korean. Kept the subject omitted; fixed only the word order (see Changes).
- **D2-F7 (P25, P55 `វឺត… វឺត…`):** readable as a phone buzz and distinct from the cicada `រ៉ឺងៗៗ…`. Kept, letter-identical at both panels.
- **D2-F8 (P37 `ចៅលោកតា`, P41 `ចៅពូ`):** the ordinary noun ចៅ is the natural word for one's grandchild; any paraphrase (កូនរបស់កូនស្រី…) would sound unnatural and add gender. លោកតា is how the firm refers to the advisor in speech (glossary row 여한목). Confirmed, unchanged; the ADDRESS clue (the advisor calling Jinu ចៅ, EP01 P39) is untouched.
- **E2-F1 (P23 `ក្មេងនោះ`):** must still point to Jinu. Ki looks down on Jinu, who has just spoken, and calls his own son កូនខ្ញុំ (EP01 P41), so `ក្មេងនោះ និយាយត្រូវដែរ មេធាវីចូ` reads as "that kid is right, Lawyer Cho": the payback lands on Jinu's side. Kept.
- **E2-F4 (P60 `…ថា` vs `…គេថា`):** chose `…គេថា` (see Changes). It carries the hearsay without naming anyone; the P57 K-15 line `ខាងលើ… ឆែកមើលហើយ។` stays letter-identical.
- **P08 / P38 touch-ups:** both edited (see Changes). P38 first bubble `ដែលអូនលើកមកនោះ…` kept (echoes P16 លើកមកនិយាយ).
- **P13 `ខ្ញុំកំពុងសុំ…`:** 준비합니다 is "preparing"; `កំពុងសុំ` in speech covers the in-progress application, and adding រៀបចំ would make an already two-line bubble longer. Kept.
- **P41 `ចៅពូខួបមួយឆ្នាំហើយ`:** a noun predicate without គម្រប់ is common in speech. Kept (it is also the glossary example).
- **Address checks:** Jinu to Deokbae លោក (never ពូ); Jinu to Bonggu ពូ (P42, P44); Taeho to Jinu អូន / អូនជីនូ, never ឯង; Sua says nothing to Jinu; ខាងលើ only, never ជាន់លើ or a name; ក្លែង nowhere.

## Kept after the meaning check

Smoother rewrites that Pass B rejected because they changed the meaning.

- P57 `ខាងលើ… ឆែកមើលហើយ។`: a smoother `ឮថាខាងលើឆែកមើលហើយ` would carry the hearsay here, but the K-15 line is binding letter for letter and ឆែកមើល must keep its មើល echo of K-13; the hearsay moved to P60 instead.
- P24 `អូនជីនូរបស់បង ពូកែមែន។`: dropping របស់បង would read smoother, but "my Jinu" is Taeho's possessive 우리 진우 (the family leash the payback turns on). Kept.
